text.tspan: Reference Asset — Asset owned by an actor, protected by a control,
and derived from an artifact in the reference model.
Reference Component — Component used to exercise interface calls,
artifact generation, implementation links, and execution links.
Reference Control — Control that mitigates risk and protects an asset
Reference Interface — Interface that can be called by a component
and exposed by a data store.
Reference Risk — Risk presented by actors/threats and mitigated by
Reference Threat — Threat presented by an actor that can present other
Secondary Threat — Secondary threat used as the target of Threat
presents Threat in the reference model.
